summary: CRITICAL: Notification hub polling is completely broken - making 825 requests in 45s instead of expected ~3 requests. The central hub is not consolidating requests as designed. Testing stopped early due to this blocking issue.

critical_bugs.issue: Central hub polling NOT working - 825 requests in 45s instead of ~3 requests (every 15s)
critical_bugs.impact: CRITICAL - Massive over-polling will cause performance issues, battery drain, and potential rate limiting
critical_bugs.details: Expected: ~3 requests to /api/notifications/{code} in 45s (one every 15s). Actual: 825 requests (~18 requests/second). The hub is either not consolidating requests or there's an infinite loop/rapid re-render causing constant re-subscriptions.

success_percentage.frontend: 0% - Critical polling bug blocks all notification features

action_item_for_main_agent: CRITICAL: Fix the notification hub polling system in /app/frontend/src/lib/notifHub.jsx. The hub is making 825 requests in 45 seconds instead of the expected ~3 requests (one every 15s). This suggests either: (1) the hub is not being used correctly by components, (2) there's an infinite loop/rapid re-render, or (3) the subscription mechanism is broken. Debug the _ensureHub, _subscribe, and interval timer logic. Verify that useRecruitNotif and useAdminNotif are properly consolidating requests. Test with DevTools Network tab to confirm polling frequency before proceeding with other notification features.
